results.evidence: tests/test_prospects_contact_address.py has two tests that import a JSON record through `prospects-import` and read the stored contacts row. test_address_only_contact_is_imported_with_its_address uses contact {address, source_url} and asserts row['address'] == ADDRESS, name is None and email is None. test_phone_only_contact_is_imported uses {'phone': '(801) 555-0100'} and asserts phone_e164 == '+18015550100'. I ran the file with .venv/bin/python -m pytest and all 6 tests passed.

The parametrized test test_contact_without_a_route_or_name_is_rejected covers two cases, a contact with only role and a contact with a blank address. Each runs prospects-import --check. The test asserts that stderr contains a rejection line naming `contact` and that stdout ends with 'check: 0 valid, 1 rejected'. I ran tests/test_prospects_contact_address.py and all 6 tests passed.

results.evidence: tests/test_prospects_contact_address.py has two tests that match the AC. test_csv_contact_address_column_is_imported writes a CSV with a contact_address column, runs prospects-import, and asserts the stored contacts.address equals ADDRESS. test_reimport_with_a_different_address_reports_the_difference imports a record, re-imports the same contact (Pat Lee) with a different address, and asserts 'contact.address' appears in the output. All 6 tests in the file passed.

Migration 006_contact_address.sql runs ALTER TABLE contacts ADD COLUMN address TEXT. tests/test_migrate.py asserts a fresh database ends at version 6 (lines 59, 61, 83, 187, 202), and I ran it with all 31 tests in test_migrate.py and test_review_candidates.py passing. test_reach_lists_the_routes_on_file in tests/test_review_candidates.py (parametrized, lines 409-445) writes contacts.address on a fresh migrated DB, so the column exists. It asserts rows[0][3] equals 'email, phone, address', 'phone', 'address' and 'none' (the deleted contact). The review header test (line 239) shows Reach is the fourth column, and CANDIDATE_LEADING_COLUMNS in review.py:126 lists it in that position. I did not run the CLI migrate command directly because the read-only gate blocked a scratch-database command. The tests exercise the same migration path.
